title: CanvasTEKK workflow run result file, layout 1.1.0
description: Platform-owned layout of a workflow run result file. Header keys come first, in this order: result_file_version, result_schema, result_schema_version, workflow_run_id, workflow_definition (optional), inputs (optional), generated_at, verdict (optional), summary (optional); body comes last. body is owned by the producing app and is never validated by the platform. summary must also be at most 2048 bytes and inputs at most 16384 bytes as compact UTF-8 JSON (checked in code; JSON Schema cannot express it). 1.1.0 adds workflow_definition, inputs and verdict to 1.0.0 and changes nothing else.

result_schema.description: App-chosen label naming the shape of body: app.kind, snake_case parts (e.g. model_check.rule).

workflow_run_id.description: Run id from the node execution request.

workflow_definition.description: The workflow definition the run executed, from the run context (CWE#1443).

inputs.description: The verdict inputs (x-verdict-marked limits, tolerances and filters) exactly as the node received them. Never every run input: those stay on the run.

generated_at.description: UTC timestamp, ISO 8601 with a Z suffix.

verdict.description: Overall verdict of the run's result.

summary.description: Optional flat key-value pairs, app-defined keys, scalar values only, at most 2048 bytes.
